The '''Corsin Run''' was an ancient route between [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] and [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]]. In [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], it was used to extend a stable path to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], eventually becoming integrated into the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
